name: warapp-mcp
description: war.app (Warzone) game advisor for Claude — your games, maps, bonuses, board analysis and routes via the GameFeed API, plus your games list (waiting on you first), opponent scouting with your head-to-head, the live board, territory picks, cards, turn planning and submission, turn notifications, and chat through your signed-in war.app tab (ContextMint Bridge). Joining, leaving or surrendering a game, closing out a finished game, accepting another player's surrender, Begin on a speed first turn, picks, turn orders, withdrawing them, chat sends, marking notifications and chat read, deleting notifications, importing local history into a hosted server and linking a session (local only) are confirm-gated.

email.title: war.app email
email.description: The email address you sign in to war.app with.

api_token.title: war.app API token
api_token.description: Your API token, shown at https://war.app/API/GetAPIToken while signed in. Changing your password rotates it.

ws_port.title: Bridge port
ws_port.description: The fetchproxy bridge port the live-game tools use to reach your signed-in war.app tab. The whole fetchproxy fleet and ContextMint Bridge share 37149; override only for local testing (or when a host injects a per-registration port). Defaults to 37149.

env_file.title: Credentials file (optional)
env_file.description: Optional dotenv file holding WARAPP_EMAIL / WARAPP_API_TOKEN. Defaults to ~/.config/warapp-mcp/.env.

transport.title: Transport (optional)
transport.description: How the live-game tools reach war.app: 'auto' (default — the chrome-less direct transport when a session is linked, else the browser bridge), 'direct', or 'fetchproxy' (browser bridge only).

session_file.title: Direct-transport session file (optional)
session_file.description: Where the linked direct-transport session is stored (default <data dir>/session.json). Local-only; a full-account credential kept at file mode 0600.

player_record.title: Player record (optional)
player_record.description: The name-free record of how other players kept truces, across games (salted hashes, no names). On by default; 'off' turns it off.

player_profile.title: Opponent profiles (optional)
player_profile.description: Counts of what each opponent did on the turns your boards showed (gameplay only, no names or chat), kept per game to profile its habits, and folded name-free (salted-hash keys) into counts across finished games. On by default; 'off' turns it off.

decision_log.title: Decision log (optional)
decision_log.description: A per-game log of each turn's view, the plan, the orders sent and, once the game ends, the true figures (player ids and numbers, no names or chat), for offline review and replay. On by default; 'off' turns it off, 'full' keeps every turn uncompacted.

chat_automation.title: Automated chat replies (optional)
chat_automation.description: Whether an agent may send chat replies you did not ask for. Off by default: chat is read, labelled and advised on, and you send every reply. 'on' lets the advice offer the exact send, and an automated send still waits for your confirmation.

chat_blocks_turn.title: Chat can block a turn (optional)
chat_blocks_turn.description: Whether unread chat that may change the turn (a truce message from a partner, a threat aimed at you from a neighbour, a surrender waiting on your acceptance, a teammate asking about this turn) stops a turn submission until it is read. Off by default: the submit preview only warns. 'on' refuses until the messages are marked seen or the submit says chat_reviewed.

timezone.title: Your time zone (optional)
timezone.description: An IANA time zone name (e.g. America/New_York). When set, every time in a tool's answer (chat, notifications, game times) also shows in your zone beside the UTC one (localTime). Unset or not a zone: UTC only.

tools.name: warapp_healthcheck
tools.description: Check that war.app accepts your email and API token

tools.name: warapp_my_games
tools.description: List your war.app games, games waiting on you first (through your signed-in tab)

tools.name: warapp_list_open_games
tools.description: List open war.app games you could join: pace, seats, entry fee and rules (works without a browser once a session is linked)

tools.name: warapp_join_game
tools.description: Join an open war.app game from the open games list (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_leave_game
tools.description: Leave a game that has not started, giving up your seat (confirm-gated), confirmed from game state

tools.name: warapp_close_finished_game
tools.description: Close out a finished game so the app's My Games stops listing it (marks its end-of-game window seen; confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_surrender
tools.description: Surrender a war.app game you are playing, or take back a pending surrender (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_accept_surrender
tools.description: Accept another player's pending surrender in a war.app game, after a preview of what it does (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_begin_turn
tools.description: Press Begin in a speed-first-turn game to reveal the board and start your turn timer (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_scout_player
tools.description: Scout a war.app player: level, games, boots, ranked records and your head-to-head (through your signed-in tab)

tools.name: warapp_get_game
tools.description: Look up a war.app game: state, turn, players and who has committed, settings digest

tools.name: warapp_get_mod_alliances
tools.description: Read the Diplomacy 2 mod's alliances in a war.app game (allied, breaking, pending proposals), read-only

tools.name: warapp_get_map
tools.description: Rank a game map's bonuses (easiest first) and find its chokepoints

tools.name: warapp_map_stats
tools.description: Opt-in (local, WARAPP_STATS=1): a map's most-picked starts, win rate by starting bonus and first-bonus turn, from finished ladder games

tools.name: warapp_analyze_board
tools.description: Advise a player from the board (GameFeed or live): income, closest bonuses, armies needed, threats

tools.name: warapp_strategy
tools.description: Strategy notes with sources, fitted to a game's format and settings, plus map notes: efficient bonuses, entry points, chokepoints

tools.name: warapp_plan_route
tools.description: Shortest path between two territories on a game's map

tools.name: warapp_get_live_board
tools.description: The live board through your war.app tab: owners, armies, fog, pickable territories

tools.name: warapp_get_my_picks
tools.description: Your submitted territory picks in priority order

tools.name: warapp_get_my_orders
tools.description: Your orders for the current turn read back from war.app, in warapp_submit_turn's shape, to resubmit after uncommitting

tools.name: warapp_plan_turn
tools.description: Plan your turn from the live board: deploys and moves by name, expected bonuses, and submit-ready orders

tools.name: warapp_check_plan
tools.description: Stress-test a list of orders before submitting: the replies one enemy deploy could make, and what each would cost you

tools.name: warapp_track_opponents
tools.description: Track each opponent over your board history: deploys per turn, income, armies hidden in the fog, and bonuses that could explain the gap

tools.name: warapp_locate_opponents
tools.description: Guess where each opponent is and what it may be doing: what you saw kept apart from likely starts, hidden territories, approaches and what to prepare for

tools.name: warapp_profile_opponents
tools.description: Profile each opponent's habits from what your boards showed: how often it reinforces, attacks, strikes first, stacks, retaliates and retakes, with counts and counter-play

tools.name: warapp_plan_picks
tools.description: Plan your territory picks: a ranked list in a compact primary and fallback group, with reasons and submit-ready ids

tools.name: warapp_submit_picks
tools.description: Submit territory picks (confirm-gated), verified by reading them back

tools.name: warapp_submit_turn
tools.description: Commit your turn's orders (confirm-gated), validated on the live board and confirmed from game state

tools.name: warapp_uncommit_turn
tools.description: Withdraw your committed orders for the current turn so you can submit corrected ones (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_get_chat
tools.description: Read a game's chat

tools.name: warapp_chat_inbox
tools.description: Read the unseen chat across all your games in one call

tools.name: warapp_get_notifications
tools.description: List your war.app in-app notifications by id, kind and game (read-only)

tools.name: warapp_dismiss_notification
tools.description: Mark war.app notifications read by id (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_delete_notification
tools.description: Delete war.app notifications by id, for good (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_mark_chat_read
tools.description: Mark a game's chat read on war.app itself (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_get_team
tools.description: Read your team in a team game: teammates (human or AI, committed or not, visible income, entered orders or picks), the team hand and unread team chat

tools.name: warapp_team_brief
tools.description: The facts for a team-chat message, never sent: pick-list overlap, picks lost, opponent incomes, my plan, asks, offers, cards and conflicts with my teammates' orders

tools.name: warapp_send_chat
tools.description: Post a game chat message, public or private (confirm-gated)

tools.name: warapp_get_relations
tools.description: Read the truces you recorded for a game: each one's state, board-derived watch flags and trust, quiet borders, and the partner's record

tools.name: warapp_advise_diplomacy
tools.description: Advise on truces in a free-for-all: each neighbour's shared border, a truce priced by planning with and without it, a verdict, an offer's three checks, and facts you may cite

tools.name: warapp_record_agreement
tools.description: Record a truce or a change to one in the server's agreement ledger and the partner's name-free cross-game record (nothing is sent to war.app)

tools.name: warapp_record_intel
tools.description: Keep avoid targets and stated incomes from diplomacy in the game's ledger, so every plan applies them by default (nothing is sent to war.app)

tools.name: warapp_backfill_history
tools.description: Give the end-of-game pass to up to 25 finished games per call (each history read once), writing only this server's state

tools.name: warapp_calibration
tools.description: Score the opponent income estimates this server planned with against finished games' truth, by format, phase, coverage, source and more (read-only, no war.app request)

tools.name: warapp_turn_history
tools.description: A game turn by turn as you saw it: the board, every player's visible orders, the plan, the orders sent and the outcome

tools.name: warapp_wait_for_turn
tools.description: Wait until one of your games is waiting on you, woken by war.app's push notifications

tools.name: warapp_recent_events
tools.description: List the game-update pushes this server has received

tools.name: warapp_session_status
tools.description: Report whether a war.app session is linked for the direct (no-browser) transport, its age, and the active transport (never the cookie)

tools.name: warapp_link_session
tools.description: Link your signed-in war.app session once for the direct (no-browser) transport, storing the cookie locally (confirm-gated)
